description: The bar chart illustrates the NDCG@10 scores across four different model configurations, as indicated by the chart's title. The horizontal axis contains the distinct categories, displaying the slanted labels "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking" in that specific order, without a general axis title. The vertical axis represents the measured value on a linear scale, starting from a minimum baseline of 0.05 and extending to a maximum of 0.25, with tick marks and corresponding horizontal gridlines appearing at regular intervals of 0.05. There are four vertical bars in total, which are not sorted in a strictly ascending or descending numerical order. The first bar, labeled "Ours", is visually emphasized in orange and represents the tallest bar on the chart, reaching an approximate value of 0.21. The remaining three bars are all colored solid blue. The "- critiquing" bar has an approximate value of 0.19. The "- scoring" bar is the shortest in the chart, indicating a value of roughly 0.075. Finally, the "- ranking" bar displays an approximate value of 0.12.
